name: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDB Airport
summary:
Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER/EDDB) is Berlin’s main international airport, located in Schönefeld about 18 km southeast of the city and serving carriers like easyJet, Eurowings, Ryanair, Condor and Sundair.

It replaced Tempelhof, Tegel and the old Schönefeld airports, becoming the single commercial airport for a region of around six million people and ranking as Germany’s third busiest. The airport opened in October 2020 after years of delays caused by severe construction and management issues.
